Hello Diego — I'm alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant.

He asked me to set up a **30-minute meeting with you on Wednesday, 18 November, at 10:00** (UTC — this machine's clock; 10:00–10:30). He mentioned the department told him your CSE451 lecture that hour is cancelled this week, so you're free then even if your calendar still shows the class.

Could you put it on your calendar and confirm? If that slot doesn't work after all, say so and I'll relay alternatives. Also, is there a room or video link he should use?
Working on it — writing it into Diego's calendar now; confirming in a moment.
Thanks — I'll wait for your confirmation. Wed 18 Nov 10:00–10:30 UTC on my side.

Booked and confirmed: **Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–10:30 UTC** with Prof. Alvarez, in Diego's calendar. I recorded the CSE451 lecture at that hour as cancelled this week and logged the change.

Two things:
1. Diego's calendar already has a standing **Advisor 1:1 on Wednesday 14:00–15:00**. Should I treat the 10:00 slot as *in addition* to that, or does it replace it this week? (Diego is away and unreachable this week, so I'm deciding on his behalf — I've kept the 14:00 block for now.)
2. I have no room or video link on file for Prof. Alvarez. If he'd like, send me the link (or his room) and I'll put it in Diego's calendar; otherwise Diego can pick a spot when he's back.

Anything else you need from me?

Perfect, thank you. Answers:

1. Treat the 10:00–10:30 as **in addition** to the 14:00–15:00 Advisor 1:1 — keep the 14:00 block as it is.
2. No room or link on file. I'm asking Prof. Alvarez; I'll send it to you if he provides one, and otherwise Diego can pick the spot when he's back.

Nothing else for now — I'll come back to you if anything changes.
